translation.name: Yoʼowe Jesukrijtota itom yaʼariakaʼu betchiʼbo juʼu bemelaka liojta betana lutuʼuria yaʼari (El Nuevo Testamento en yaqui)

content: Paplo, jume' a' ta'aa'um tebotua
Jamuttaka, Krijtopo itomak werik, Peebe' teamta, inen ne enchim a' ta'aaka a' ju'uneiyaa i'a. Aapo, senu jo'ara Senkrea' tea'po, Krijtota sualeme nasuk, te'opopo, tekilta joaka am ania.

Inika'a junuen, eme'e, tu'isi a' mabetne, yo'owe Jesukrijtota itom nau suale'po amani, Krijtopo nau wewerim bem emo bit'ea'a benasia. Intok eme'e, jita'po juni'i a enchim a' ania'ut a' aniane. Bwe'ituk aapo yu'in yee aniala, intok kia nee juni'i aniala.
Risiila' teamta intok Akiila' teamta nee am tebotuariane. Inime'e, Jesukrijtota betana juka' tekilta nemak a' bo'o jooriame.
Inime'e, bempo nee jinne'ubaekai, jinilwatchisi emo bichak. Junuen san tu'isi ne am bai sae, intok ka inepo jiba, taa ket si'ime wame'e, ka juriomtaka, si'imekut aneka, Krijtota sualeme am bai sae.

Ket jume' Krijtopo itomak werim, Risiilata intok Akiila' teamtaim jo'apo nau yaajame em tebotuane. Intok ketchia, juka' Epaineeto' teaka in jalla'i in nake'uta a' tebotuane. Ini'i juna'a ju'u bwiaraa Aasia' tea'po, che'a bat Krijtota sualekame.
Juka' Maria' teamta ket tebotuane. Aapo emo nasuk, Jesukrijtota betchi'bo yu'in tekilta ya'ari.

Ket Anrooniko intok Juniaj ti teakame, jume' nemak joomem, am tebotuane. Inime'e ket ya'uraau nemak e'etasuak. Krijtota yeu pu'arim betana ket, inime'e eiyaawa. Intok ket che'a nee bepat Krijtota sualeka au emo su'u tojak.
Juka' Aapliaj teamta, yo'owe Jesukrijtota, nemak sualeka in nake'uta, in jalla'i, a' tebotuane.
Ket juka' Urbaano' teamta tebotuane, Jesukrijtota betana itomak tekipanoamta. Intok juka' in nake'uta, Taakij teamta.
Juka' Aapelej teamta nee ket tebotuariane. Jesukrijtota a' suale'po amani, junuen tua lutu'uriatuka'po ju'uneiyaawame. Intok ket jume' Arijtoobolo' teamta yoemiam nee ket tebotuariane.
Juka' nemak jometa, Erooriaano' teamta a' tebotuane. Intok jume' Narsiiso' teamta yoemiam, jume' Krijtota sualeme.

Jume' Ripaaina intok Ripoosa' teame ket tebotuane. Inime'e, jume' yo'owe Jesukrijtota tekilta joame. Intok juka' Krijtopo itomak werik, Persiira' teamta itom nake'uta. Ini'i ket, yo'owe Jesukrijtota tekilta yu'in a' ya'ala.

Juka' Ruupo' teamta ket tebotuane. Ini'i, jume' Krijtota sualeme nasuk, Krijtota tu'isi a' suale'po ta'eewaka eiyaawa. Intok a' aewata, juka' ket nee betchi'bo in ae benasi in eiyaa'uta, a' tebotuane.

Ket jume'e, inen teakame nee am tebotuariane, Asinkrito' teamta intok Leekon teamta, intok Ermaj teamta, intok Patroobaj teamta, intok Ermej teamta, intok si'ime jume' waate Krijtota sualeka amemak aneme.

Intok ket jume' inen teakame ne am tebotuariane. Pilooloko' teamta, Juuliaj teamta, intok Nereeo' teamta, intok a' akkoowata, intok juka' Olimpaaj teamta. Intok si'ime jume' Krijtota sualeka ama amemak nau yaajame.
Si'ime eme'e, Krijtota enchim nau suale'po aman, em naas emo tebotuanee tua emo nakekai. Si'ime jume' te'opommet Krijtota nau sualeme, utte'esia emou tebotemme.

Krijtopo itomak werim, emou ne ujbwana, jume' Krijtota sualeme nasuk, ka nau eewamta joaka intok yee ji'optuame, enchim am mammatene' betchi'bo. Bwe'ituk ini'i weyeme, bem joa'u, Krijtota betana juka' enchim a' majtawaka'uta, beje'eka weye. Juname'emak eme'e ka emo tu'urine.

Bwe'ituk juname'e, itom yo'owe Jesukrijtota betana weyemta, bempo, kaita tu'ik jooa. Ala bempo, bem tu'ureka, bem bwa'anee'ut jiapsek. Intok inime'e, aa noki'ichiae, juebenam am sualtua, wame'e, jita juni'i sualeme, jikkaji maisi ujyooisi ameu nokakai.

Si'imem betana eme'e ju'uneiyaawa, Liojtau si'imeku enchim nok jikkajaka, au enchim emo su'u tojila'po. Inia betchi'bo san ne ama butti emo tana allea. Intok inepo, tu'ik jiba enchim bo'o joorianee'u betana sussua i'a. Taa juka' ka tu'ik joo betchi'bo ka junuen jiapsine.

Ju'u intoko Lios, yanti elaka jiapsiwamta yetet autuame, aapo, Jesukrijtotamak eakai, lauti juka' bebeje'erita, tokti enchim a' koba'anee'ut enchim aniane. Itom yo'owe Jesukrijtota betana juka' emou tu'ik eme'e mabetne.
Ju'u Timoteo' teame ket emou tebote. Ini'i, Jesukrijtota betana, tekilta nemak joame, Intok ketchia ju'u Luusio' teame, intok Jason teame, intok Sosiipatro' teame. Inime'e in nemak joomem.
Inepo, Teertio' teame, Paplota betana inika'a ji'ojteita emou ji'ojteme, ket ne, inepo, yo'owe Jesukrijtota in emo mak suale' betchi'bo ne enchim tebotua.

Ju'u Kaayo' teame ket junuen enchim tebotua. Inia jo'apo san inepo kateka, bitwa. Intok ketchia, ini'i, si'ime jume' inim Krijtota sualeme, a' jo'awapo nau yaaji betchi'bo am mabbeta. Ju'u Erajto' teame ket enchim tebotua. Ini'i, ju'u inim bwe'u jo'araapo Korinto' tea'po, ya'uraa tomita nau toji betchi'bo, tekilta joame. Intok ket ju'u Krijtopo itomak weri, Kuarto' teame enchim tebotua.
Ji'ojtesuka, Paplo, Liojta yo'oritebo

I'an intoko itepo, Liojta te yo'orine, juka'a, Jesukrijtota, che'a juni'i, ka ta'abwisi intok, enchim a' sualnee'ut enchim anianemta. Liojta betana juka' bemela lutu'uriata, in yee a' majta'apo amani. Intok Jesukrijtota betana, juka' nok lutu'uriata yee a' majtawa'ue. Ini'i intoko, aniata kee ju'unaktewao, kaabeta ju'uneiyaaka, taa i'an, Liojta yeu machiari mak weye.

Taa ala i'ani, jume'e, Liojta betana ju'uneiyaaka a' ji'ojtekame ji'ojteka'ue, ju'uneiyaawa, Liojta juka' jiba yuu jiapsamta nesaweka'po amani. Ini'i bemela lutu'uria, i'an si'ime ka nanau yoemra a' ju'uneiyaatuari, junuen bem a' sualne' betchi'bo intok bem a' nok jikkajine' betchi'bo.
Lios, ju'u aapolaika, intok si'ime suawakame, jume' Jesukrijtota a' sualeme betana a' yo'orinaa'u, jiba yuu betchi'bo au aune. Intok tua junuentune.
